Furthermore, standalone TCGDBs, without a glass cover, can benefit systems that require protection from the environment while necessitating out-of-plane light and charge transport, such as photoelectrochemical (PEC) systems. With further refinement, the TCC can pave the way for improved encapsulation techniques to provide the element of “added functionality” to the triad of low-cost, efficient, and stable characteristics desired in next-generation PV technologies.
